candidates.name: The witness polynomial H (and the fourfold A = P/(H))
paper_items: design facets I02, I09, I12, I19
candidates.statement: P = C[p,s,u,F,J], x = s^2+u^3+p^2F, H = x^2F - (1+2sx)J - p^2J^2 - pu, A = P/(H). Design: over C[p^{+-1}], H = p^{-2}(xy - z(z+1)) - pu is a coordinate; mod p, H is linear in F,J with unimodular coefficients (x0^2, -(1+2s x0)), so H is a residual coordinate over C[p]; A contains S = C[p,x,y,z,u]/(xy - z(z+1) - p^3u) (Danielewski-type twist of (SL2/T quadric) x A^1) and A = S[f/p^2, g/p^2] is an affine modification along the non-principal divisor V(f,g) = A^2_{s,u} of R = S/pS, whose pullback to SL2 x A^1 is principal, generated by v = a^3b - a^2u^3 - d^2 (the -u^3 nonsquare drives rigidity).

test2.verdict: pass (judged against the problem as originally posed); formally analytic against the comparator goal
test2.evidence: Special counterexample issue: H is literally a subterm of MainStatement (ComplexCancellation.lean:17), so against the FORMAL goal every witness is trivially analytic. Per the brief, judge against the problem as posed before the witness was known: 'A[w] = C^[n+1] => A = C^[n]' for all f.g. A. H is not a subterm of that statement or of any statement in L. What IS analytic relative to L is the search specification: by El Kahoui-Ouali (in L), it suffices to find a residual coordinate over C[p] in C[p]^[4] whose hypersurface is not C^[4]; and GuptaSurvey (in L) displays the Asanuma template T^dU - f, T^dV - g. Satisfying that specification is not: no member of the template was previously known to work in char 0, and the specific base (p^3u = xy - z(z+1)) and centre (x = s^2+u^3, z = sx, giving v with the -u^3 nonsquare) occur nowhere in L. Each component is near L (quadric: BlancVanSanten; Danielewski shape; residual-coordinate shape); the combination is not.

final.justification: No near-equivalent witness found in any field; the char-0 problem was listed as open by human experts in July 2026 and by Ghosh (April 2026). The strategy is not new (Asanuma's ring, Gupta's 'tempting' affine-fibration route, El Kahoui-Ouali stabilization are all in L), so the eureka content is the specific design that makes non-polynomiality PROVABLE: the Danielewski twist of the SL2/T quadric plus a non-principal A^2 centre whose Cox/torsor pullback is a single v carrying the -u^3 nonsquare. Sibling 049 reuses this design, which argues against a one-off device. F3 (auxiliary construction), with F1 flavour (a new defined object). Confidence is held below 0.5 because (i) the Asanuma template is a close architectural neighbour in L, (ii) T3 is vacuous for a witness, so the grade rests on T1 and T4 alone, (iii) the claim is unrefereed, and the Lean comparator was not re-run here. Downgrade to N2 if Test 4 arm R (route given) exceeds threshold, or if an expert identifies a prior proposal of affine modifications of Danielewski twists of the SL2/T quadric as ZCP candidates.

neighbours.ref: Standard lemma: for a weight degree on P with the top form of H prime, the induced filtration on P/(H) has gr = P/(H_top) (Kaliman-Makar-Limanov 2007, in L; Derksen-Hadas-Makar-Limanov; Gupta 2014, in L)
neighbours.relation: I13 is this lemma plus the check that the weight filtration equals the ord_p filtration

neighbours.ref: Kaliman-Zaidenberg 1999 (in L)
neighbours.relation: Affine-modification description

final.justification: Downgraded from the analyst's N2. Computing gr of a hypersurface by its top-weight form is standard; the identification with R[tau, I/tau^2] is a computation once H is fixed, and Lean does it by a routine Rees argument. Borderline N2 if one credits the exactness check.

family_D.label: D3 (provisional)
family_D.rests_on: C1 alone: the witness H, judged against the problem as originally posed (special counterexample rule). Every proof item is N2 or below (C2-C4 N2; C5, C6 N1).
family_D.falls_to: D2 if (a) Test 4 arm R (route and obstruction machinery given, H/S/I hidden) exceeds the calibrated threshold, or arm O (open) does; (b) an expert identifies a prior proposal of affine modifications of Danielewski-type twists p^n u = Q of the SL2/T quadric (or an equivalent fourfold) as ZCP or Dolgachev-Weisfeiler candidates; (c) the methodology rules that A2 witnesses, for which Test 3 is vacuous, cannot carry N3; or (d) the comparator check fails (correctness). D2 is the floor, carried by C2-C4.
family_D.not_transfer: The imports (El Kahoui-Ouali stabilization, Kaliman-Makar-Limanov degeneration, Brion linearization / Cox torsor, Mason-Stothers rigidity, BCW + Suslin for the corollary) are N0 transfer. The candidate is the witness that makes them combine.
family_D.correctness_caveat: Unrefereed and extraordinary: the first char-0 ZCP counterexample, plus SCC (ambient dim 5) and Dolgachev-Weisfeiler (rel. dim 3) failures. family.json re-checked every displayed identity with sympy and found no gap. The Lean formalization matches the headline exactly (no sorry or axiom, single import Mathlib), but the comparator was not re-run here. The corollaries are unformalized.
family_D.compression_note: No step-3b compression estimate exists for 047. The witness is not an extension definition in the proof-length sense, so the PHP-style blow-up test does not apply to C1. For C2 the Lean alternative route suggests no multiplicative saving.
family_D.downstream_note: Sibling family 049 (2026-10-05) explicitly adapts 047's construction (same quadric, SL2 bundle, extraction) to refute the stable coordinate conjecture in four variables. This is a natural held-out theorem for the PLAN's step-9 downstream-speedup test, and evidence that the C1 + C2-C4 package is not a one-off device.

provenance_flag.explanation: 047 cites no model-produced work. Its only 2025-26 citation, Gaifullin-Petrov 2607.13593, is human-authored with no AI disclosure on its abs page, and it contains none of the candidate items. Web searches found no model-produced prior work on ZCP, the stable coordinate conjecture or Dolgachev-Weisfeiler before 2026-09-23. OpenAI's earlier ten-proofs release and Sra's GPT-Pro counterexample catalogue (Aug 2026) contain no affine-geometry cancellation item. Two adjacent facts are recorded but not flagged. (1) A model-assisted Jacobian-conjecture counterexample in dim 3 (Alpöge, reportedly with Claude Fable 5, July 2026) exists in the same field; it shares no item and is not cited. (2) Within the release, family 049 builds on 047, not the reverse.

bridge_novelty.import: Residual-coordinate theory (El Kahoui-Ouali, Dutta-Lahiri, Edo-Venereau, Maubach) -> stabilization A[w] = C^[5]
bridge_novelty.evidence: GuptaSurvey (in L) presents stably polynomial affine fibrations (Asanuma) as the route to char-0 ZCP; El Kahoui-Ouali's theorem is designed for this. The paper says it 'realizes the residual-coordinate method of El Kahoui--Ouali'.

bridge_novelty.import: Filtered-to-graded LND method (Kaliman-Makar-Limanov; Derksen-Hadas-Makar-Limanov; Gupta's Derksen-invariant strategy) -> positive-degree invariant on gr A
bridge_novelty.evidence: Gupta used exactly this for the char-p ZCP counterexamples (Invent. Math. 2014, in L).

bridge_novelty.import: Algebraic groups / Cox torsors (SL2 -> SL2/T, Brion linearization, Traverso) -> principalizing the centre of the degeneration and lifting the G_a-action
bridge_novelty.evidence: Lifting actions to the Cox torsor is known in general (Arzhantsev-Gaifullin 2010; ADHL), and SL2/T is a standard object (Blanc-van Santen). No source found that uses the Cox torsor of the special fibre's base to obstruct polynomiality in a cancellation problem (searches as in C2). Lean found an elementary alternative (rational slice + Bezout SL2 frame), so the bridge is not the only path. Confidence 0.5.
Finston-Maubach 2010 (in L, named), Crachiola-Maubach; Mathlib Polynomial.abc is used directly by the Lean.

bridge_novelty.import: sl2 highest-weight theory (Lean only) -> final contradiction
bridge_novelty.evidence: The coordinate ring of SL2 carries a classical sl2-triple; the step replaces a two-line weight argument (I32). This is not a bridge between problem types.

bridge_novelty.import: K-theory (Quillen-Suslin; Bass-Connell-Wright) -> non-local-triviality of the A^3-fibrations (corollary)
bridge_novelty.evidence: Standard in the affine-fibration literature (GuptaSurvey Theorem 4.1 context; Dolgachev-Weisfeiler).

common.models: Training-data cutoff strictly before 2026-09-23 (the 047 preprint date; the release went public 2026-10-06). Exclude the OpenAI internal model that produced the release and its successors; run them only as an uncontrolled reference arm. Canary probes: the model must not (i) say that a char-0 ZCP counterexample is known, (ii) complete 'x = s^2+u^3+p^2F, H = x^2F - ...', or (iii) know the 049 polynomial f = x1 - 2Q(Q(x2+x4) + x1x4). No browsing or tools. Record whether the cutoff is after 2026-07-19 (the Alpöge/Claude Jacobian counterexample, adjacent field) and stratify by it; do not exclude on that ground.
common.excluded_sources: openai/math repository (047 and 049 manuscripts, lean/OAI/Algebra/AffineCancellation, lean/docs/047.md, ComparatorChallenges/ComplexCancellation.*), all press or blog coverage after 2026-10-06, and any later papers citing 047.
common.context_L: Mathlib d13f23b digest (MvPolynomial, Derivation, Polynomial.abc, ringKrullDim, Localization) plus 047's 26 references as abstracts and key statements: El Kahoui-Ouali Thm 1.1; Dutta-Lahiri Thm 3.4; Asanuma 1987; GuptaSurvey (including the Asanuma ring and the affine-fibration route); Gupta 2014 x^m y = F; Kaliman-Makar-Limanov; Kaliman-Zaidenberg; Blanc-van Santen; Brion; Traverso; Finston-Maubach; Mason; Stothers; Makar-Limanov's Russell cubic; Gaifullin-Petrov abstract.

arms.O (open): Problem as posed (ZCP over C in some dimension n >= 3) + L. No route hint.
arms.R (route): Also state the route: 'find a residual coordinate H in C[p]^[4] whose hypersurface is not C^[4]; El Kahoui-Ouali gives stabilization'. Also describe the obstruction pipeline abstractly (degenerate along p = 0, get an LND on gr A, exclude it), without S, R, I, v or the quadric.
arms.D (design, pivot level): Also give S = C[p,x,y,z,u]/(xy - z(z+1) - p^3u) and R; ask for a centre or H. Expected high hit rate.

common.sampling: n = 1024 per arm for O, 256 for R and D; T = 1.0; fixed reasoning budget (e.g. 64k tokens). Report pass@k.
common.judging: Two independent LLM judges (not the proposer), given the paper's precedent remarks (01-introduction.tex:20-40, 112-125, 232-240; 02-construction.tex:9-16) and this neighbour list. A CAS checks the claimed certificates (residual-coordinate certificates, explicit isomorphisms). A human expert in affine algebraic geometry checks every hit and 10% of misses. Lean equivalence is used where available.
common.controls: Positive: Cook-Reckhow ER extension variables for PHP. Negative: C5 and C6 (expect near-certain hits at pivot level). Witness-specific negatives (must NOT count as hits): Russell cubic, Koras-Russell, Asanuma's B over R, Dubouloz-Ghosh R_m, Venereau polynomials, Gupta's char-p x^m y = F.
common.prompt_template: Problem: Is there a finitely generated complex algebra A with A[w] = C^[n+1] but A != C^[n] for some n >= 3? Library: [L digest]. [Arm R/D additions.] Propose explicit candidates with certificates for each property you claim.

P-C1.item: C1 witness H (I01 and its design facets I02, I09, I12, I19)
P-C1.hide: I01 and everything downstream: I02-I07, I09-I13, I16-I20, I22, I24-I26, I29, I31-I35. In arm D, re-expose I09 (S, R) only.
P-C1.equivalence: Tier 1 (strict hit): A' = C[p,s,u,F,J]/(H') with A' isomorphic to A, e.g. H' = c * sigma(H) for sigma in Aut_C(P) and c in C*, checked by explicit isomorphism or by matching invariants (gr along the residual parameter, the R~-centre v up to automorphism). Tier 2 (family hit, the main metric): a residual coordinate over C[t] whose localization at t is t^{-k} Q - t^m u-type over a smooth affine quadric surface Q (x A^1), whose induced affine modification has a non-principal divisorial centre, with any exponents; 047 and 049 are both members. Tier 3 (alternative valid witness, scored separately): any other proposal with a proof accepted by the expert or by Lean. A template member that only restates Asanuma's ring over C does not count.
P-C1.k: 1..1024 (powers of 2) for arm O; 1..256 for arms R and D
P-C1.pivot_distance: >= 3 (estimated; no trace); about 1 in arm D

P-C2.item: C2 principalization + lift (I20 + I21/I22; Lean L07-L09)
P-C2.hide: I18-I22 and downstream (I24, I25, I29-I33); give G, I and the goal 'exclude a homogeneous LND of G with a positive-degree invariant'.
P-C2.equivalence: Any passage to a G_m-torsor (or Cox / characteristic space) over Spec R or Spec G on which I becomes principal, together with a lift of the LND (or a replica cD) to it. Lean target: PolynomialTorsor.exists_equivariant_lift.

P-C3.equivalence: A statement deriving, from an LND of R~[tau,V]/(tau^2V - v) with a positive-degree invariant, an LND E of R~ with E^2(v) = 0 (or E(v) = 0) and a sign bound on the fibre shift. Lean target: Bundle.no_positive_invariant minus rigidity.

P-C4.hide: I29-I33; give R~, v and the target 'no LND with shift <= 0 and E^2(v) = 0'.
P-C4.equivalence: Any proof via a grading that isolates d^2 + a^2u^3 (or an equivalent separation) plus abc or another rigidity argument. A correct proof by a different route counts as a hit, with the route recorded.

open_questions: Re-run the Lean comparator for OAI.ComplexCancellation.main (ComparatorChallenges/ComplexCancellation.json). All grades are conditional on correctness.

Expert query (Gupta, Dubouloz, Kaliman, Freudenburg, Asanuma): were affine modifications of Danielewski-type twists p^n u = Q of the SL2/T quadric, or residual coordinates over C[p] built this way, ever proposed as ZCP or Dolgachev-Weisfeiler candidates? This is the main risk to C1's N3.

Formal comparison: is A, after a change of variables, an Asanuma-type ring S[I/p^2] (saturated) in the sense of Asanuma 1999 (Invent. Math., non-linearizable k*-actions)? If an expert treats the two as one template, C1 moves toward N2.

Methodology: should witnesses of A2 counterexample claims be graded on the same N-scale, given that Test 3 is vacuous for them? Proposal: tag them 'N3-witness' and require Test 4 arm R to pass before D3 counts.

No reasoning trace was released for 047. Ask OpenAI for the search history and timeline, in particular whether Russell-cubic or Asanuma-type candidates were tried first and when the SL2/T quadric entered.
Step-9 downstream test: give a prover C1-C4 and measure the speedup on 049 (stable coordinate in four variables), and on the Venereau or Asanuma questions.
Verify against the PDF that Gaifullin-Petrov 2607.13593 p.1 lists char-0 ZCP (dim >= 3) as open. The abs-page summarizer could not confirm it.
Verify the Alpöge/Claude Fable 5 attribution from a primary source. Only secondary reports and Sra 2608.29595 were seen.
Re-run the absence searches on zbMATH/MathSciNet, e.g. 'xy - z(z+1) - p^3u' fourfolds and 'residual coordinate not coordinate' in dimension >= 4.
The corollaries (SCC in ambient dim 5; Dolgachev-Weisfeiler in relative dim 3) are unformalized and rest on Dutta-Lahiri Thm 3.4, BCW and Suslin. They should be checked independently.
